author: Yffe
content: Increment 1f build: extend the Lean S_C fragment to the SPEC-CONTEXT REWRITES, proven denotation-preserving + ref_sound. Ast.lean += mutual Expr/RangeArg with seqVar/strVar/idx/subrange/seqLen/byteAt (mirror Expr::Index/Ref/MethodCall, IndexArg). Denote.lean += structure Env{ints,seqs}, seqIdx/seqSub, mutual seqVal/intVal (the source @/element/prefix/byte/length meanings). RefEncode.lean += VerusByteView + encByteAt/encLen/byteView (the #127 dispatch), mutual refSeqVal/refIntVal faithful to ref_encode.rs encode_slice_arg/encode_index/encode_ref/encode_string_byteview. Soundness.lean += combined refVal_eq (mutual structural recursion) + byteView round-trips + the #127 negatives byteview_wrong_index_breaks_soundness / byteview_misdispatch_breaks_soundness. lake build green, axioms [propext], no sorry. Lean core only. Commit to main (#178) ref #169, do not close (critic re-audits).
